create_init_args_gaussian: create an InitArgs dataclass with gaussian initialization enabled and default settings
create_init_args_uniform: create an InitArgs dataclass with uniform initialization by setting use_gaussian to False
create_init_args_no_init: create an InitArgs dataclass with no_init enabled to skip weight initialization
get_init_fn_gaussian: get a truncated normal initialization function for a PyTorch tensor with given input dimensions
get_init_fn_uniform: get a uniform initialization function for a PyTorch tensor with custom standard deviation multiplier
